rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site, multi-scanner; [11C]-(+)-PHNO model: 2 scanners (PET/CT Hi-Rez Biograph 6 and PET/MR Biograph mMR) at 1 site (Invicro, London); [18F]FDOPA model: 5 scanners (Hi-Rez Biograph 6, Biograph 40 TruePoint, TruePoint 6, ECAT HR+962, ECAT EXACT 3D) across 3 sites (Invicro London, MRC Cyclotron Unit London, Bundang Hospital South Korea)

rci5_n.detail: Overall phase; all HC used for model estimation with k-fold cross-validation (k=5) for internal validation. [11C]-(+)-PHNO: 54 (PET/CT) + 23 (PET/MR) = 77 HC. [18F]FDOPA: 61 (FDOPA_01) + 26 (FDOPA_02) + 12 (FDOPA_03) + 36 (FDOPA_HC01) + 7 (FDOPA_HC02) = 142 HC
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Data from 77 HC (Table 1) from two previous studies [40, 41], acquired with [11C]-(+)-PHNO, were used to assess and select the best image harmonisation method." "6-[18F]fluoro-L-DOPA (FDOPA) data from 142 HC and 109 patients with psychotic disorders from previous studies [7, 13, 14, 42-48] were used for estimating the NM of dopamine synthesis capacity"
rci5_n.location: Giacomel2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study datasets, L49 and L83; Table 1

rci6_sex.detail: [11C]-(+)-PHNO: summed from PET/CT (22F/32M) and PET/MR (12F/11M) = 34F/43M. [18F]FDOPA: Table 1 reports combined HC+patient sex for case-control datasets (FDOPA_01, FDOPA_02, FDOPA_03), so HC-only sex is not separable for 99/142 HC; HC-only datasets report FDOPA_HC01: 14F/22M and FDOPA_HC02: 1F/6M (covering only 43/142 HC)

rci7_age.detail: [11C]-(+)-PHNO: weighted mean and pooled SD computed from PET/CT (N=54, mean=26.52, SD=7.87) and PET/MR (N=23, mean=24.39, SD=4.90); age range not reported; age in years. [18F]FDOPA: Table 1 reports combined HC+patient age for case-control datasets (FDOPA_01, FDOPA_02, FDOPA_03), so HC-only age is not separable for 99/142 HC; HC-only datasets report FDOPA_HC01 (N=36, mean=29.42, SD=6.09) and FDOPA_HC02 (N=7, mean=24.43, SD=4.65), covering only 43/142 HC; overall HC age cannot be reliably computed
